CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Rajesh Kumar, Advocate For the Opp. Party : Mr. Sudhir Kumar Mahto,
A.P.P.
-----
2/ 07.11.2025 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Latehar P.S. Case No. 168 of 2024 corresponding to Special POCSO Case No. 43 of 2024 for the offences registered under Sections 376(1), 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 and 6 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of learned Special Judge, POCSO, Latehar.

3. Prayer for bail of this petitioner was earlier rejected by this Court vide B.A. No. 668 of 2025 by order dated 29.01.2025.
4.

The petitioner is alleged to have established consensual physical relationship with the informant,
who is a minor girl aged about 15 years.
5. Attention has been drawn towards the statement of the victim recorded during trial, in which, she has stated that she has lodged this case on the pressure of her family members.
She has also stated that the petitioner has not subject her to any sexual atrocity.
6. In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, the Jitendra Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand ....
